releaseNotesKm: ម៉ោងផ្តោតអារម្មណ៍ថ្មី៖ ធ្វើការជាវគ្គ ហើយសម្រាករវាងវគ្គ ព្រមទាំងចំនួននាទីថ្ងៃនេះ និងសប្តាហ៍នេះ។ គ្មានអ្វីរត់ក្នុងផ្ទៃខាងក្រោយឡើយ ដូច្នេះទោះបិទកម្មវិធីក៏វគ្គនៅតែត្រឹមត្រូវ។ វគ្គដែលបញ្ចប់មុនកំណត់រាប់តែពេលដែលធ្វើពិត។
releaseNotesEn: A focus timer built so it cannot lose your session. Nothing ticks in the background - a running session is a start time and a length in the database, so force-stopping the app mid-session changes nothing and the battery cost is one alarm. It is honest about what you did: a session stopped early records the minutes it really ran, and one you forgot to stop is capped at what you planned rather than crediting nine hours.
